svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1113 commits across five public projects, 68 active days, peak 126 commits per day. 2026-08-31 through 2026-11-22 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-22T22:26:12.069Z.
